nodes.description: MT1-MMP is the dominant pericellular collagenase of connective tissue cells. Without it, fibroblasts, chondrocytes, skeletal progenitors and osteocytes cannot cleave the type I collagen that surrounds them, so the matrix of developing bone, cartilage and soft connective tissue is not turned over. Reviews of the MMP14, MMP2 and SH3PXD2B disorders and their animal models identify defective collagen remodelling as the shared central lesion of the spectrum. Loss of osteocyte process formation in Mmp14-null bone has been attributed to the same failure of collagen cleavage.

nodes.description: The carpal and tarsal "osteolysis" that defines the syndrome may reflect abnormal formation and modelling of these bones rather than excess resorption. Carpal and tarsal bones ossify from subarticular cartilage by a process distinct from growth-plate endochondral ossification, and osteoclast (TRAP) staining is notably absent there at the developmental stage relevant to the human disease. This reinterpretation rests on normal mouse developmental anatomy and has not been tested in MMP14-deficient carpal tissue.

nodes.description: Skeletal stem cells use MT1-MMP to remodel their collagen niche, and the resulting change in cell shape activates beta1-integrin, RhoGTPase and YAP/TAZ signalling that commits them to the osteoblast lineage. Deleting Mmp14 in mesenchymal progenitors, but not in committed osteoblasts, diverts these cells towards adipocyte and chondrocyte fates and produces generalized osteopenia without a change in osteoclast number.

nodes.description: MT1-MMP is a pericellular activator of the gelatinase MMP-2. Fibroblasts from the original Winchester proband secrete abundant pro-MMP2 but convert little of it to the active enzyme, and tissues from Mmp14-null mice are likewise deficient in pro-MMP2 activation. The p.Thr17Arg variant abolishes pro-MMP2 cleavage in a transfection assay, whereas the hypomorphic p.Arg111His variant retains partial activity, and the authors propose that this activation step is the main determinant of severity.

nodes.description: Biallelic MMP14 missense variants reduce the amount or the activity of MT1-MMP at the cell surface. The signal-peptide variant p.Thr17Arg impairs processing of the nascent protein, so it is rapidly degraded and almost no active enzyme reaches the plasma membrane. The milder pro-domain variant p.Arg111His is processed and trafficked normally but has reduced proteolytic activity, and the milder phenotype it produces suggests that residual catalytic activity sets disease severity.

nodes.description: During skeletal development, unmineralized cartilage templates are normally dissolved by MT1-MMP in step with apoptosis of their chondrocytes and replaced by bone, tendon or ligament. In MT1-MMP deficiency these cartilages persist, and both endochondral and intramembranous ossification are impaired; the mmp14a/b knockout zebrafish shows the same enlarged, disorganized cartilage cores with sparse bone matrix.
